tools.name: get_stablecoin_scores
tools.description:
Current SII scores (0-100) for scored stablecoins. Use before any decision involving stablecoins.

    Parameters:
        limit: max coins returned (default 25, max 500)
        fields: columns to return per coin (default id, symbol, name, issuer,
            score, grade, confidence, stale, comput

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description:
The Basis methodology. mode="summary" (default): index list, versions,
    component counts. mode="full": the complete SII formula, weights and
    component specifications (large).

tools.name: basis_data
tools.description:
Market, governance and risk data in one tool. Pick a kind:

    liquidity_depth (entity=coin id), yield_data (entity=protocol, optional),
    governance_activity (entity=protocol slug; window=days, 90),
    bridge_flows (entity=bridge id, optional), exchange_health (entity=exchange id, optional),

tools.name: basis_answer
tools.description:
Ask the Basis Agent a question about attested risk state.

    Answers cite attestation hashes; ungroundable queries are refused. Never
    recommends positions or forecasts. Pass your hub API key (x-api-key header
    or ?apikey=) to attribute reads. Multi-turn: pass the envelope's
    session_id b

tools.name: receipt_verify
tools.description:
Verify a receipt or citation hash from an envelope (basis_answer, entity_read).

    Resolves it against the attestation tables and returns what it attests
    to, or that it is unknown. ``source`` optionally restricts the table.

tools.name: entity_read
tools.description:
Look up any entity by symbol, slug, contract/wallet address, operator or vault name.

        Returns {entity_type, id, score, grade, confidence, receipt_hash,
        links}. When nothing resolves returns {match: null, did_you_mean:
        [up to 5 candidates]} rather than an error.

tools.name: score_history
tools.description:
Daily SII score history for a stablecoin: a list of {date, score, grade} only.

        Parameters:
            coin: symbol, slug or contract address (resolved like entity_read)
            days: lookback window, 1-365 (default 30)

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "basis_answer" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
